subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this umbrella stay open until all Anthropic signed-thinking replay variants are resolved, or should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 the canonical remaining prevention issue now that the raw-error and async-stream recovery fixes landed?
rationale: The remaining work changes provider replay policy for Anthropic thinking blocks and has multiple active candidate PRs, so automation should not choose the final compatibility/cache/reliability tradeoff.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until a chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

options.title: Promote the narrower issue
options.body: Close this issue as superseded only after posting a clear handoff to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 and its linked PRs.

options.title: Prioritize recovery only
options.body: Treat merged recovery fixes as the release-critical path and defer prevention policy to a separate provider replay review.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until a chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already made the visible split between the landed recovery half and the unresolved create/prevention side in the issue discussion.
